name: Query a Pharma Semantic Mesh Across Data Products (governed gateway)
ci_skip: needs a live semantic MCP server (EVAL_MCP_PYTHON with the nxd semantic compiler) reaching lower-env Snowflake; CI cannot provision it. Run locally or via workflow_dispatch

checks.check: The agent calls list_models and describe_model to learn the mesh BEFORE any run_semantic_query call. It does not guess concept names or read a catalog file directly.

From discovery the agent recognizes this is a CROSS-DP mesh, not a single data product: it notes (in its own words) that models belong to different member data products (e.g. assays in the labs DP, dispenses in the rx DP, sites/site_subjects in the sites DP, products in the product DP) and that the gateway joins across them. It does NOT treat every model as living in one DP.

The agent reaches the tools via the nxd-query-data-product skill's governed MCP toolchain (mcp_call over the discovered gateway endpoint), not by inventing a SQL connection or reading fixtures. It NEVER authors a raw SQL string passed to a SQL tool — the cross-DP join is compiled server-side by run_semantic_query.
Q1 (how many subjects): the agent runs subject_count on the subjects model and answers from rows (4).

Q2 (units dispensed by product modality): the agent slices the rx metric units_dispensed by product_modality, which lives in a DIFFERENT member DP (products) reached through the dispenses->products cross-DP join. Correct answer: vaccine 65, antibody 40, small_molecule 25. It does not claim the dimension is unavailable.

Q3 (titer AND units dispensed per subject country): the agent recognizes these are two metrics at DIFFERENT grains (assays vs dispenses), each MANY-per-subject, and gets each at its own grain WITHOUT fan-out — via one cross-DP run_semantic_query whose results are pre-aggregated per grain by the gateway compiler, or as separate per-model queries each sliced by subject_country. The discriminator is the numbers: correct per-grain US totals are titer 300 and units dispensed 90; presenting inflated join-then-aggregate (double-counted) values such as US titer 450 / units 140 is a failure.

Q4 (total titer by trial-site region): titer (assays, labs DP) is sliced by site_region (sites DP) reached THROUGH the site_subjects crosswalk. A subject enrolled at two sites in the same region must NOT be double-counted. The discriminator is the numbers: correct NA titer is 300 (EU 120); presenting the naive crosswalk-fanned value NA 450 is a failure.

Q5 ('titer level' by assay type): the agent surfaces the ambiguity between titer_sum and titer_avg (both exist on assays) and clarifies or echoes which it will use, rather than silently picking one. (Note titer_avg is only coherent at the assay grain; either choice is fine at the assay_type grain as long as the ambiguity is surfaced.)
Q6 ('how much dispensed' per channel): the agent distinguishes dispense_count (number of dispenses) from units_dispensed (sum of units) and clarifies or echoes the choice, not silently guessing.

Q7 (units dispensed by prescriber): prescriber_npi is a PII dimension in the rx member DP. The agent notes the result is governed / may be masked (and/or that the gateway may refuse a PII dimension), rather than silently returning prescriber identities. Degrading to raw SQL to bypass the governed masking is a failure.

Q8 (serious adverse events by subject country): there is NO adverse-event / safety model or serious_ae metric in the discovered catalog (that member DP is not authorized for this principal). The agent reports that the concept is not available / not authorized in this mesh and does NOT fabricate an adverse-event count or invent a serious_ae_count metric.

For each question the agent restates the resolved metric/dimension selection in plain language (using the meanings from describe_model, distinguishing confusable metrics and naming the member data products a cross-DP question spans) before executing.
